title: auth.dsr.erasure_approved v1
description: Canonical USER/SUBJECT-level GDPR/LFPDPPP erasure fan-out trigger. Emitted DURABLY by svc-auth GDPRService.approve_dsr via the transactional outbox (ADR-117 §13) when a data-subject ERASURE request is approved. Published as {"message": json.dumps(payload)} on stream alebrije:events:auth and consumed by every module to purge the subject's data. FLAT payload (does NOT use the envelope.v1 data-nested shape) — fields are top-level, matching the real producer at gdpr_service.py:191-218 and the consumer parse paths. Supersedes the legacy auth.user.deletion_requested event (no longer produced; consumers accept it only for backward compatibility). DISTINCT from the tenant-offboarding Temporal saga (TENANT granularity).

event_id.description: UUID4 uniquely identifying this event (uuid4() in producer). Used for consumer-side dedup (processed_events). Flat legacy producers may omit it; canonical producer always sets it.

event_type.description: Canonical event type. Consumers route on this exact value.

schema_version.description: Producer-emitted schema version. Currently '1'. Note: flat payload uses schema_version (not the envelope's event_version).

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the data subject. The event carries its own tenant_id so each consumer scopes its purge (ADR-25).

user_id.description: UUID of the data subject (User) whose data must be purged across all modules.

dsr_id.description: ID of the originating DataSubjectRequest. Used as the idempotency/audit anchor by consumers.

data_subject.description: Resolved data-subject identity for cross-module audit. Email resolved from the User record (falls back to dsr.email).

email.description: Data-subject email at approval time, for the erasure audit trail.

audit.description: Approval/legal-deadline audit metadata set by svc-auth at approval time.

approved_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of DSR approval. Consumers map this to their effective erasure-request time.

approved_by_dpo.description: User ID of the DPO who approved the DSR; null if unassigned.

legal_deadline_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC legal deadline (dsr.legal_deadline_at or requested_at + LEGAL_DEADLINE_DAYS).
